items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that theater over here on Rampart Street. I forgot the name of that thing. You mean what Schumann had when I was playing Piran?

ctx.x: It's still there. Yeah. I played there about three years, every night.

When you talk about Opera House, well, you're going to say something about a theater. You mean the old French Opera House? Yeah, but other people, I wanted to ask, this is interrupting and changing the subject again, that theater over here on Rampart Street. I forgot the name of that thing. You mean what Schumann had when I was playing Piran?
That's before you. Yeah, I played at the Silver Slipper, you mean that's, Yeah, I guess that's. Because Piran was directing my band at the Silver Slipper.
